    The Tits form of a representation-directed piece is weakly positive #

    Let F be a family of relations generating those of a piece S, with Tits form q_F(x) = Σᵢ xᵢ² - Σ_α x_{s α} x_{t α} + Σ_r x_{s r} x_{t r}. If every nonzero indecomposable module over the piece algebra is rigid (for instance directing), then every dimension vector x has a representation X respecting the cover with no cocycles beyond coboundaries (exists_rigid_rep; a module of minimal endomorphism dimension, ASS IX.3.3). Counting cocycles gives dim End X ≤ q_F(x) (finrank_end_le_titsF). So q_F is weakly positive (one_le_titsF), and a positive vector with q_F(x) ≤ 1 is the dimension vector of a brick (exists_brick_of_titsF).
